messages:
emma.partnerships: Quick sync — we need to align on AWS/GCP/Azure listing assets, AMI/VM images, SKUs and entitlements for next week's marketplace submission. Who's owning AMI IDs and legal review?

 tom.product: I can own product packaging + pricing SKU mapping. Need final feature list and supported regions.

 sarah.legal: I'll take legal review but need the licensing table + data residency statements. Share draft T&Cs link.

 alex.eng: I'll handle AMI/VM builds. Quick question — do we need separate images per region or can we reference shared AMI IDs?

 matt.cloudops: For AWS we need per-region AMIs; GCP/Azure can use generalized images but we must provide image URIs. I'm happy to coordinate the build pipeline.

 jess.marketing: Heads-up — we want a joint announcement tentatively 2 weeks after listing. Need logos, short product blurb, and a single-sentence "what's included" for the marketplace card.

 emma.partnerships: Action items: @tom will do SKU mapping, @alex + @matt will produce AMI/image URIs, @sarah will run legal by Tue EOD, @jess will assemble marketing assets. Can we get status updates in this thread? :thumbsup:

 marketplace-bot: Preflight check: missing fields detected: 'support_contact', 'privacy_notice', 'billing_sku'. See https://redwood/internal/marketplace/preflight

 tom.product: Adding suggested SKU mapping snippet:
 ```
 SKU | Feature | Billing_unit
 R-INF-STD | Hosted API access, 50k tokens/mo | monthly
 R-INF-DED | Dedicated capacity, baseline SLA | monthly
 ```
 I'll drop a CSV in the drive.

 alex.eng: AMI naming convention we used:
 ```
 redwood-inference-<model>-<region>-sha256:<shorthash>
 ```
 Current AWS AMI list:
 - us-east-1: ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890
 - eu-west-1: ami-0123456789abcdef0
 I'll push build artifacts to s3://redwood-marketplace/images/1725-build

 sarah.legal: Uploaded initial T&Cs draft: https://redwood/legal/marketplace/1725-terms.docx. Comments by Tue please. Data residency lines look OK for EU/US but need APAC clause clarification.

 matt.cloudops: For GCP, images:
 ```
 projects/redwood-global/global/images/redwood-inf-1725
 ```
 Azure: managed image IDs will be provided by Thu. Also checking entitlement mapping for enterprise SKUs.

 jess.marketing: Draft blurb for listing:
 "Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference: hosted API, dedicated pools, and private deployments with predictable latency and cost controls."
 Can we shorten to 120 chars for the marketplace card?

 emma.partnerships: Great. Deadline recap: AMIs/images + URIs by Thu, SKU CSV by Wed, legal sign-off Tue EOD, marketing assets Wed EOD. We'll do a final preflight on Fri. If anyone needs extra time flag now.

 tom.product: noted. I'll upload CSV tonight.

 alex.eng: confirming AMIs by Thu.

 sarah.legal: I'll aim for Tue but flag if APAC clause needs deeper review.

 marketplace-bot: Preflight re-check scheduled for Fri 09:00 UTC.

 jess.marketing: tagging design for a 120-char headline: @design-team please help.

 emma.partnerships: thanks team — moving to checklists doc: https://redwood/partnerships/checklists/marketplace-onboard-1725
